earlierAttempts.boundary: New tests targeted hidden segmented/rating radio inputs. Firefox/WebKit additionally exposed the documented Playwright cross-shadow accessible-name matcher limitation. Source unchanged throughout run.
Fourteen new gallery journeys pass in all engines. Rating clear text matched both explanatory text and control. Final test targets its documented clear-option surface.

limits: 38 executed copies per engine means27 gallery modules plus11 complete API modules, not38 different component families.59 copied modules compile.
21 gallery modules still lack independent runtime journeys; exact IDs are recorded in galleryInventory.pending.
The two eager scoped color fixtures remain separately authored controls.
The native consumer uses packed public library imports and locked third-party modules, with explicit gallery registration and actual copied application handlers.

Label references and native activation are verified in all three engines. Chromium native AX additionally checks the computed external field label. This does not establish Firefox/WebKit native AX names or spoken output.
Native color acceptance uses the HTML input value/change boundary; OS color-picker interaction remains manual.

These bounded journeys do not replace owning SSR, theme, accessibility, API or platform matrices. Remaining public-layer, native Firefox comparison, physical/manual and separate-owner obligations remain open.
